Technologies: Python, yfinance, python-telegram-bot, Cron

Built an automated market gap scanner that fetches live stock data daily at 9:17 AM via a cron job and analyzes price gaps across a watchlist. Implemented gap detection logic to flag stocks exceeding ±1% threshold, filtering actionable signals from noise. Delivered structured gap reports to a private Telegram group using the Telegram Bot API, restricted to authorized members.
